Any living creature who dies from this damage rises at the start of the next round in the target's space as a specter under the Director's control. > 👤 **Hidden Movement** > > | **-** | **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** | > |-------------|-------------:| > | **📏 Self** | **🎯 Self** | > > **Effect:** The specter turns invisible, moves up to their speed, and is visible again. > ⭐️ **Corruptive Phasing** > > The specter can move through creatures and objects at their usual speed, but can't end their turn inside a creature or object.
